control_explanations: Initial shape test expected unit-length normals although the existing builder uniformly scales normals before shader normalization. It also omitted the 8 mm root offset when testing the fern ribbon. Corrected fixture, not a normalization production change.
The initial liquid vertical gate excluded walkable lava ledges; measured authored levels justify a separate 3 m lava gate, keeping water at 1.2 m.
Coarse lava chunks missed the sparse crust pocket. The authored scan now includes all actual lava buckets.
The outdoor four-candidate lattice missed valid snow pockets; an independent 1 m cave lattice retains exact footprint/topology and density limits.

Earlier NUL literal generated Unicode diagnostics; final code validates code points without constructing a NUL string. regional-moss-gl1 has zero assertions failed but is not included in clean accepted runs.
The first LiA inventory attempted a declared but absent zone17.mpr; the corrected read-only inventory records it explicitly instead.
limits: No Android/browser acceptance or net FPS claim. Other render processes recorded in each run.
Regional shaders add 16 bytes per cave cover vertex and new geometry/shadow work; default off.
Original liquid centres provide approximate habitat bands, not exact shoreline collision.
Rigid patch/debris edges follow a root rather than each footprint-trench point.
No one-to-one reference shape-variant parity, gameplay-wide visual acceptance or survivor compaction.
Prior coastal depth/mean-water error and unrelated Mobile/Compatibility restoration limitations remain.
